method: ABBA fresh processes per platform, five trials per case per process; 128 slices of 128 KiB or 16 slices of 4 MiB; 200 UTF16 units retained. Reference output uses full UTF16 conversion. All results compared within timed loop. Input/reference construction and JSON/hash output excluded. Serialized local benchmark lane on a shared workstation; last CPU sample was 1 percent before measurement. Allocation bytes are cumulative C++ new requests, not process RSS.

windows_control.method: Follow-up ABBA with unchanged runtime code, verified logical CPU 0 affinity inside each benchmark process, and at least 500ms of per-case warmup before timing. Both original and control data are retained. This controls a pronounced within-process warm-up trend; it does not identify the sole cause of that trend.
